selection: 128 lowest SHA256('SAMECALL-B0|' + example_id) from train1421 excluding all 128 SAMECALL-A0 pilot IDs
batching: interleave old/new prompt for each query in the same 32-request batch
primary: paired 0.90 success, all-attainable Complete, five anchor success and Target prompt+generated tokens at depth9 and depth10
research_gate: GO prompt-only design if at depth10 0.90 net repair >=5/128, Complete does not regress, each attainable anchor has no net regression worse than 3/128, and mean Target tokens per query rise by at most 25%; this opens design only, not deployment or sealed evaluation
